findings.reason: §2's own done-when must name the whole read-authority set it retires (or the §6 census must state that `read_qualification`/`read_batch` callers are re-pointed), otherwise the qualification entry the solve depends on survives beside its successor.
findings.text: §2's replacement set names `Topology.read` and `read_with_connectivity`, but the read authority the production solve actually uses is `Topology.read_qualification` (topology.py:1125), reached from `forward.py:2762` and `ForwardFluxOperator._fixed_design_read` (forward_operator.py:2990, which the plan names only as a call site under the region census); `read_batch` (topology.py:1415) and `split_flux_map` (topology.py:1100) are further unnamed read authorities, so the new `topology.read` (topology.py:2889) lands as a parallel read owner rather than a replacement

findings.reason: §5 must add one cite-or-justify line for the coefficient-space Newton and fixed-point map so the new solver is not silently a second Newton owner in the same package.
findings.text: §5 adds `solve.fixed_point` and lists its reuse candidates (`_single_site_krylov`, `reduced_newton`'s `newton_direction`/`residual_request`, the backtracking helpers), but does not cite `coefficient_carrier.py`, which already owns a Newton solve over a declared fixed-point map (`dense_newton`, `coefficient_fixed_point_map`, `exact_fixed_point_map`); the plan's own house rule is cite-or-justify for every such candidate

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the four pure functions (`read`, `book`, `apply`, `fixed_point`) each hide substantial behaviour (contour-tree census and normal-form saddle support; exact-clip booking; geometry-operand flattening; Newton-GMRES with line search) behind one call site, which is the deep-module shape.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §2 names `Topology.read` (topology.py:1396) and `read_with_connectivity` (topology.py:1376) for replacement but leaves `read_qualification` (topology.py:1125) — the actual production read entry the solve reaches — unnamed, so the new `topology.read` would sit beside a surviving authority doing the same job.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §6 retires `SolveRoute`, `SupportClipMode` and eight `ForwardSolvePolicy` plumbing fields, and every §2–§5 section names the machinery it replaces (`Topology.read`/`read_with_connectivity`, `clipped_support_current_moments`, the `ForwardFluxOperator` map, `newton_krylov`/`picard`), so no section adds tracked surface without stating what it retires or merges.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §5's Newton-solver reuse rulings name the GMRES kernel in `fixed_point.py`, `reduced_newton.py`'s step helpers and the backtracking helpers, but not `nova/equilibrium/coefficient_carrier.py`, which already carries a Newton solve and a fixed-point map (`dense_newton`, `coefficient_fixed_point_map`, `exact_fixed_point_map`).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the retained `forward.py` request/receipt adapter and the `ForwardProfile.operator` seam are existing machinery being re-pointed onto the new modules, not a new layer added over them, and each new module replaces named machinery (`clipped_support_current_moments`, the `ForwardFluxOperator` map, `newton_krylov`/`picard`).
